text:
sophie_customer: Hey team — my free trial credits haven't decreased even though I made ~12 generate calls this morning. UI still shows 1000 credits. Can you confirm?

emma_support: Sorry about that — can you share the account email and 1-2 request ids (x-request-id) if you have them? Also which SDK/version?

sophie_customer: account: sophie@acmecorp.com. I have two request ids from logs: req_9a2f and req_9a2f-dup (looks like client retried). Using node-sdk v1.4.2 with default retries.

emma_support: thx. I'm pulling your usage ledger now. one sec. :mag: (checking internal billing tool)

emma_support: infra-bot: query ledger for acct sophie@acmecorp.com around 1767990000..1768002000 -> returned 1 write for req_9a2f at 1768001201, no writes for subsequent retries.

ryan_billing: jumping in — the ledger shows only the first write, but since you did repeated calls they should each consume credits. curious why client retries suppressed ledger writes.

sophie_customer: so only one call was counted even though the app attempted 12. I wasn't expecting retries to be deduped. Is that expected?

emma_support: it can be expected if client uses the same idempotency key for multiple logical requests. But your SDK default shouldn't do that across separate requests. what does your retry wrapper look like?

sophie_customer: honestly just left default node SDK; didn't set idempotencyKey manually.

jorge_eng: quick check from infra — we're seeing a recent billing-worker change that rejects ledger writes when idempotency-key length > 64 bytes, and in that code-path we accidentally skip the write (no error surfaced to the runtime). Some SDKs generate long trace-like ids in retries.

lisa_pm: wow. that could explain multiple customers reporting similar symptoms this week. What's the scope?

jorge_eng: preliminary: affects requests where the computed idempotency-key >64 chars AND the request hit a worker with the new schema rollout (partial region rollout Thu morning). In that combo we returned 200 to client but didn't record usage.

emma_support: so the customer saw success responses and assumed credits were used — but ledger omitted them. we need to: 1) fix the bug, 2) reconcile affected accounts, 3) provide customer remediation.

ryan_billing: I've started a manual ledger replay for sophie@acmecorp.com for the missing request ids. Will also add a temporary credit hold so they're not charged incorrectly on expiry.

sophie_customer: appreciate it. any ETA on fix? I'm worried other customers might hit this.

jorge_eng: just opened PR: https://git.redwood/infra/billing/PR-834 — root cause is idempotency-key validation raising an internal flag but swallowing write. Fix: normalize/truncate idempotency-key server-side to 64 chars and return 409 if duplicate, otherwise proceed. Adding guard and better logging.

jorge_eng: repro steps: run the following (simulates SDK retries with long idemp key):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY"
  -H "Idempotency-Key: $(python -c "print('x'*80)")"
  -d '{"model":"redwood-1","input":"hi"}'
```
You should previously have seen 200 but no ledger write. With fix you'll see 200 and a ledger entry (or 409 on duplicate).

emma_support: timeline?

jorge_eng: hotfix merged to staging. Rolling to prod in 30m with a scoped flag to only affect billing-worker instances. Full rollout this evening after monitoring.

ryan_billing: reconciliation plan: run ledger replay for any accounts with success responses but zero usage in the ledger between 1767900000..1768005000 and reconcile with request logs. We will top-up affected trial accounts to original balance + consumed credits and log an audit entry.

sophie_customer: thanks. can you confirm my trial balance will be back to what it should be (minus legitimate usage)?

emma_support: yes — we're topping up any missing consumption so you won't lose trial time. I'll DM you when the manual replay completes.

infra-bot: deployment: billing-worker v2.1.3 -> prod start 1768001400, status: rolling, 20% nodes updated.

jorge_eng: follow-up: cause ticket TIFF-412 created, root cause and mitigation documented. We'll also add a warning in SDK changelog recommending customers rotate long idempotency keys as a short-term workaround.

emma_support: Sophie — update: we completed manual replay and adjusted your trial balance at 1768004800. Please refresh your Console; you should see credits reduced to account for the successful calls and not double-counted.

sophie_customer: saw it, thanks! appreciate the quick turnaround. :raised_hands:

lisa_pm: adding this to weekly postmortem and to the onboarding checklist so SDKs avoid generating >64 char idempotency keys by default.

emma_support: closing the thread — cc'ing you on the reconciliation ticket. If anything else crops up ping support. :white_check_mark:
